snippet.title: Fearless Pinocchio Arcade
snippet.description:
Pinocchio's father was kidnapped by evil Captain Hook. In order to save his father, Pinocchio has to fight fearlessly and bravely against the evil pirate. 
No doubt that it is going to be a journey full of hardships, yet it is what players are expected to overcome with.

The game is played with 8-way joystick and a single button, the player can do multi combo and supers depending on the direction of the attack, the higher combos you do the better is the end game score.

Players get tickets for every opponent they defeat. The more opponents they defeat, the more tickets they get.
